Package io.webagent4j.observation

package io.webagent4j.observation
The immutable semantic observation model, options, renderers, diff, fingerprint, and the batch-capture backend SPI (io.webagent4j.observation.spi) - depends on webagent4j-dom and webagent4j-locator-api only, never on a browser backend.

Observation is the result of one passive, bounded capture - reading it never re-queries the live page. ObservationOptions bounds what a capture retains (element/depth/text/table limits, hidden-element and input-value inclusion); applied limits always surface in ObservationStatistics, never silently. Password, token, and credit-card controls are always redacted regardless of options - see ObservedValue.

The orchestrator that turns a backend's PageSnapshot into this model - IObservationEngine - lives in webagent4j-observation, the separate engine module this dependency inversion exists to allow: IPage#observe() exposes only these immutable contracts and the capture SPI, never the engine or a backend type. See docs/observation.md for the full semantic model and redaction contract.
